ul.li: Use speaking variables even in iterations even in iterator functions. They can be brief like pluginUiTriggers.map(trigger => ...) but not 1 or 2 characters
Favour iterators over loops. Use loops only when there is a reason, do not use classic for loops
Favour a single options argument object over multiple parameters
Use early returns to reduce nesting
we need an undo history. consider building diff data for the composition, but you may suggest other ways.
the main tool ui needs a color picker
with active selection, effects must be only applied to the selected part of the active layer
layers should be selectable by pointer event in the renderer

paint strokes look good, but transformed layers need to compensate when painting. consider these options: 1. transform the stroke to match the layer transform 2. build the layer itself as a composition with the image data at the bottom. 3. suggest improvements
we need to be able to zoom in/out on the renderer
the transform bounding box should be visible outside the rendering canvas
